name: Visual Basic
summary: Adversaries may abuse Visual Basic (VB) for execution. VB is a programming language created by Microsoft with interoperability with many Windows technologies such as Component Object Model and the Native API through the Windows API. Although tagged as legacy with no planned future evolutions, VB is integrated and supported in the .NET Framework and cross-platform .NET Core. strategies.name: Behavioral Detection of Visual Basic Execution in ICS

analytics.name: Analytic 2091
analytics.guidance: Real-time monitoring identifies wscript.exe/cscript.exe, Office macro, or HTA-driven Visual Basic execution from unexpected parents/paths or followed by PowerShell, command shell, network activity, or system modification. Alert only when the interpreter is not part of the asset's approved software/automation baseline or its execution context violates an approved signer/hash/path/parent/user rule, and require OT-relevant corroboration such as access to engineering files, ICS software/API use, communications with protected OT assets, configuration change, or another suspicious follow-on behavior.
